people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Israel was greatly impoverished by Midian, and the Israelites cried out to the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites; and the children of Israel cried unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And Israel was brought very low because of Midian; and the children of Israel cried unto Jehovah.
